NFL DFS Quarterback Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 8, 11:18 AM ET

Brock Purdy is the top-projected quarterback on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 22.1 DraftKings points for $6,800, against Las Vegas. Patrick Mahomes (21.1, $6,100) and Dak Prescott (20.4, $6,500) are next.

Drew Lock returns the most per dollar among quarterbacks projected for at least 15 points: 4.29 projected points per $1,000 at $4,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 8, 11:18 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Quarterbacks to know in Week 9

Brock Purdy, SF vs LV ($6,800)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.1 DraftKings points at $6,800, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.0 points clear of Patrick Mahomes. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.25 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 21 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Purdy averaged 22.1 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 40.2, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 9.5-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 30.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Patrick Mahomes, KC vs NYJ ($6,100)

Patrick Mahomes projects 2nd at the position with 21.1 DraftKings points at $6,100. The model includes 3.4 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.45 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 21 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 21.1 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 39.3, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Drew Lock, SEA vs ARI ($4,000)

Drew Lock projects for 17.2 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 4.29 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.3 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Lock averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 31.4, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 39.5.
